name: Low Poly Ak 74M Zenitco
designation: AK-74M 5.45x39mm assault rifle with Zenitco furniture
operating_principle: The AK-74M operates on a gas-operated, long-stroke piston action, utilizing the high-pressure gases produced by the firing cartridge to cycle the action and chamber a new round.

components.description: The barrel group consists of the barrel and related components.
The gas system includes the gas block, tube, and piston, which harness the high-pressure gases to cycle the action.
The bolt and bolt carrier group are responsible for chambering and extracting the cartridge.
The receiver and dust cover house the bolt and bolt carrier group, and provide a mounting point for the barrel and other components.
The fire control group includes the trigger, hammer, and selector, which control the firing of the rifle.
The feed system consists of the magazine and related components, which supply the rifle with ammunition.
The furniture includes the stock, grip, and handguard, which provide a comfortable and stable platform for the shooter.
The sights include the front and rear sights, which provide aiming references for the shooter.
